name: Yoga school in Rome
reason: No school's own website found in three searches. Candidates (Centro Yogadarshana with a four-year teacher course, Scuola Asia Darshana, Accademia Yoga di Consapevolezza, the Sivananda centre in Via Tommasini, Lino Miele's Ashtanga Yoga Research Institute) appeared only in directories and course portals (Emagister, Superprof, Fitprime, Recommended) or old articles; domains are never guessed. A Squarespace page in the results turned out to be Ashtanga Spirit Munich, not Rome.
